title: 第3章 聚力丹
content_zh:
此等异象足足持续了一个时辰，陆凡悠悠转醒。

身躯微微有些僵硬，稍微动弹，便发出一片清脆的声响。

起身，陆凡弹掉身上的风雪，感觉自己的身体好像与原来有些不同，但却又说不出到底是哪里不一样。

迈步走回陆家大门，刚刚走入门内，陆凡便看到陆明正带着张月涵在逛陆家的前院，旁边还围了一群陆家子弟。

这些人，陆凡有的认识，有的见过几次面，但都没什么好印象。

听闻身后有人进来，陆明也转过头来。

见到是陆凡，陆明嘴角又扬起一抹讥讽的笑容。

拉着张月涵缓步上前，陆明对着陆凡道：“来，废物堂弟，给你介绍一下。这是张月涵小姐，问声好吧。”

张月涵已经低下了头，看起来似乎是有些害羞，但实际上却是根本不敢看陆凡的眼睛。

陆明顿时竖眉，冰冷的目光注视着陆凡，在他看来，一个废物也敢在自己面前摆谱无疑是找揍。

旁边一名略胖的青年走上前替陆明拦住了陆凡。

“陆凡堂弟，你一句话都不说就想走，未免太失礼仪了吧，不要丢了陆家的人。不会是废物到变哑巴了吧。”

陆凡抬头看着他，此人也算是他的堂哥，不过是旁系的，名为陆天罡，算是陆明的死党。

陆凡缓缓道：“不关你事，不要挡道。”

陆天罡登时怒了，大手猛推了陆凡一下。

陆天罡的实力，陆凡是知道的，炼体五重，比他要强多了。按理说以陆天罡的力量，一把将他推倒都是不成问题的。

但这次，陆凡居然一步未退，只是身躯摇晃了一下，便站住了脚步。

抬眼看着陆天罡，陆凡道：“你想打架吗？”

一句话，顿时让陆天罡抬起的手又放了下来。怒目圆睁，陆天罡却还是不敢伸手打陆凡。

陆家的家规还是很严的，其中最严厉的一条，就是不许欺负小辈。刚好，陆凡比陆天罡小一岁，未满十八。陆天罡如果真的敢打陆凡，那等待陆天罡的将是至少百日的禁闭。对于一个年轻人来说，关在小黑屋不许出门一百天，这个惩罚可谓不轻了。

陆天罡咬牙道：“陆凡，你等着。我现在不打你，但年祭的时候，你跑不了的。到时，我一定把你打的满地找牙。”

陆凡冷眼看着他，根本一句废话都懒得多说，径直离去。

陆天罡被气的不轻，还想拦住陆凡，但陆明却阻止了陆天罡，道：“算了，跟一个废物计较什么。”

陆明的声音，故意说得很大，让陆凡也能听见。

拍了拍陆天罡的肩膀道：“等年祭，你好好揍他。”

陆天罡咧嘴道：“放心，我肯定揍的他生活不能自理，让他变成一个从此连床都下不来的废物。”

站在一旁的张月涵居然也跟着笑了起来。

陆凡走回自己的院子，作为陆家嫡系子弟，他有着一个长满杂草的小院。

其实相比较陆明等人，陆凡的院子已经很寒酸了，但陆凡不在乎。

院子里有一块石头，一人来高，这是陆凡的练功石。

走到石前，陆凡深呼吸一口气，重重一拳打在石头上。

蓦地，一声闷响，练功石上出现了一个拳印，细小的龟裂纹路出现，陆凡当场愣住。

以他炼体三重的实力，是绝不可能一拳打出此等效果的，这是炼体四重以上才拥有的力量。

陆凡看着自己的拳头，不敢置信。他已经卡在炼体三重很多年了，今天终于有提升了？

炼体三重与炼体四重虽然只差了一重，但其实差别还是很大的。

因为在炼体境，一至三重，被称为低等。四到六重则就叫做中等了。七到九重，算是高等。

一个中等炼体境的人，完爆三个低等炼体境绝对没有问题。

陆凡带着惊疑，又对着练功石打出一拳。感受着力量从拳头倾泻而出，将面前的练功石再度砸出一道拳印，陆凡终于可以肯定，自己的实力确实到了炼体四重。

激动的陆凡挥了挥拳头，只要有进步，就说明他在武学方面还有救。

可是他为何会突然提升，陆凡记得他炼前三重的时候，每一次提升都要经历撕心裂肺的痛苦，仿佛肌肉撕裂一样。

蓦地，陆凡脑中想起了老吴的酒，不会是。。。。。。

正在陆凡思索之时，脚步声由远至近，一名虎背熊腰的中年男子走了进来，这个不过四十岁的男子已经有了白发，看起来略带憔悴。

见到此人，陆凡立即收起了脸色的表情，恭敬的道：“父亲。”

陆昊尽量用平静的语气道。陆凡的面色微变，他大概已经猜到父亲要跟他说什么了。

咬着牙，陆凡道：“您说吧，父亲。”

陆昊眼中带着凄然，缓缓的道：“陆凡。家族开过会了，此次年祭过后，所有修为不足的人都将外放，去小城镇，打点家族生意。”

“父亲，你不必自责，是儿子不争气，让您失望了。”

陆昊摆手道：“不，陆凡。不关你的事，是为父没有尽到责任。你从小身体就不好，气血两虚，疾病缠身，本就不该让你修武。是我一意孤行，让你练武，却没想到将你变成了家族的笑柄。错全在我，你的努力，我都看在眼里，你无错。”

陆凡感觉自己的眼眶微微有些湿润，拳头紧握。

陆昊接着道：“陆凡，我现在想听听你的选择。如果你选择离开家族，我保你去最好的城镇，掌管家族的关键生意，富贵安稳一生，不成问题。”

“好，不愧是我儿子。败不馁，坚如磐石。陆凡，我也尽我所能，助你一臂之力。”

说着，陆昊从怀中掏出青花瓷的小瓶，递给陆凡道：“拿着，这是聚力丹。你今晚服下，至少可先帮你增加些力量。”

陆凡怔在原地，丹药，父亲居然给了他一瓶丹药。

陆凡知道丹药是多么珍贵的东西，又是多么难得。这是罡武大陆极其稀少的炼气士才能炼制的东西。

所谓炼气士，是一种高贵的职业。他们有着不虚武者的力量，并且比武者手段更多，能力更强。最突出的，便是他们可以用药材炼制各种丹药，每种都有着不同的功效。比之一般药材，要好了不知多少。

如果不是因为炼气士人数太少，门槛太高，恐怕这片大陆就不是叫罡武大陆了。

陆凡小心翼翼的结果青花瓷瓶，感动的无以复加。

哪怕是最低等的一颗丹药，市场价也绝对超过几个位置不错的商铺，还有价无市。像江临城这种一般的城市，据说也只有每年的拍卖场会卖出一到两颗。

陆凡不知道自己的父亲付出了怎样的代价才拿到这颗丹药，但看着父亲的白发，陆凡就知道他为自己操碎了心。

陆凡郑重的道：“父亲，我不会让你失望的。”

陆凡望着父亲离去的背影，紧紧的捏住了手中的药瓶。

content_en:
This vision lasted for a full hour before Lu Fan slowly woke up.

The body was slightly stiff, and when it moved slightly, it made a crisp sound.

Getting up, Lu Fan flicked the wind and snow off his body. He felt that his body seemed to be a little different from before, but he couldn't tell what was different.

Walking back to the front door of the Lu family, Lu Fan saw Lu Ming and Zhang Yuehan walking around the front yard of the Lu family as soon as they entered the door, with a group of Lu family children surrounding them.

Lu Fan knew some of these people, and had met some several times, but none of them had a good impression.

Hearing someone coming in from behind, Lu Ming also turned around.

Seeing it was Lu Fan, Lu Ming raised a sarcastic smile again.

Pulling Zhang Yuehan forward slowly, Lu Ming said to Lu Fan: "Come on, good-for-nothing cousin, let me introduce you. This is Miss Zhang Yuehan, please say hello."

Zhang Yuehan had lowered her head. She seemed a little shy, but in fact she didn't dare to look into Lu Fan's eyes.

Lu Ming suddenly raised his eyebrows and stared at Lu Fan with cold eyes. In his opinion, a loser who dared to show off in front of him was definitely looking for a beating.

A slightly fat young man next to him stepped forward to stop Lu Fan for Lu Ming.

"Cousin Lu Fan, it would be too rude of you to leave without saying a word. Don't lose the Lu family. You won't be such a waste that you become mute."

Lu Fan raised his head and looked at him. This person could be considered his cousin, but from a collateral lineage. His name was Lu Tiangang, and he was Lu Ming's best friend.

Lu Fan said slowly: "It's none of your business, don't get in the way."

Lu Tiangang became angry immediately and pushed Lu Fan hard with his big hand.

Lu Fan knew about Lu Tiangang's strength. The fifth level of body refining was much stronger than him.Logically speaking, with Lu Tiangang's strength, it would be no problem to push him down.

But this time, Lu Fan didn't take a step back. He just shook his body and then stopped.

Looking up at Lu Tiangang, Lu Fan said, "Do you want to fight?"

With one word, Lu Tiangang immediately lowered his raised hand.His eyes widened with anger, but Lu Tiangang still didn't dare to reach out and hit Lu Fan.

The Lu family's family rules are still very strict, and the most stringent one is that you are not allowed to bully your juniors.It just so happened that Lu Fan was one year younger than Lu Tiangang, under eighteen.If Lu Tiangang really dares to hit Lu Fan, what awaits Lu Tiangang will be at least a hundred days of confinement.For a young man, being locked up in a dark room and not allowed to go out for a hundred days was a serious punishment.

Lu Tiangang gritted his teeth and said, "Lu Fan, just wait. I won't beat you now, but you won't be able to run away during the New Year Festival. Then, I will beat you until your teeth are all over the floor."

Lu Fan looked at him coldly and left without even bothering to say anything.

Lu Tiangang was very angry and wanted to stop Lu Fan, but Lu Ming stopped Lu Tiangang and said, "Forget it, why bother with a loser."

Lu Ming's voice was deliberately loud so that Lu Fan could hear it.

He patted Lu Tiangang on the shoulder and said, "Waiting for the New Year Festival, you can beat him up."

Lu Tiangang grinned and said: "Don't worry, I will definitely beat him until he can't take care of himself and turn him into a useless person who can't even get out of bed from now on."

Zhang Yuehan, who was standing aside, actually started laughing too.

Lu Fan walked back to his yard. As a direct descendant of the Lu family, he had a small yard full of weeds.

In fact, compared to Lu Ming and others, Lu Fan's yard is already very shabby, but Lu Fan doesn't care.

There is a stone in the yard that is as tall as one person. This is Lu Fan's practice stone.

Walking to the stone, Lu Fan took a deep breath and punched the stone hard.

Suddenly, there was a muffled sound, a fist mark appeared on the practice stone, and tiny cracks appeared. Lu Fan was stunned on the spot.

With his strength at the third level of body refining, it is absolutely impossible to achieve such an effect with one punch. This is a power that can only be possessed by the fourth level of body refining and above.

Lu Fan looked at his fist in disbelief.He has been stuck at the third level of body refining for many years, and he finally improved today?

Although there is only one level difference between the third level of body refining and the fourth level of body refining, the difference is still very big.

Because in the body refining realm, the first to third levels are called inferior.Levels four to six are called medium.Level seven to level nine is considered advanced.

There is absolutely no problem for a person in the medium body refining realm to complete three low body refining realms.

With surprise and suspicion, Lu Fan punched the training stone again.Feeling the power pouring out from his fist and smashing the training stone in front of him to create a fist seal again, Lu Fan was finally sure that his strength had indeed reached the fourth level of body refining.

The excited Lu Fan waved his fist. As long as he made progress, it meant that he still had hope in martial arts.

But why did he suddenly improve? Lu Fan remembered that when he was practicing the first three levels, he had to experience heartbreaking pain every time he improved, as if his muscles were torn.

Suddenly, Lu Fan thought of Lao Wu's wine, it couldn't be......

While Lu Fan was thinking, footsteps came closer and closer, and a burly middle-aged man walked in. This man, who was only forty years old, already had gray hair and looked slightly haggard.

Seeing this person, Lu Fan immediately put away his expression and said respectfully: "Father."

Lu Hao tried his best to speak in a calm tone.Lu Fan's expression changed slightly. He had probably guessed what his father was going to say to him.

Gritting his teeth, Lu Fan said, "Just tell me, father."

With sadness in Lu Hao's eyes, he said slowly: "Lu Fan. The family has held a meeting. After this New Year's Festival, all those with insufficient cultivation will be released to small towns to take care of family business."

"Father, you don't have to blame yourself. It's your son who failed to live up to expectations and let you down."

Lu Hao waved his hand and said: "No, Lu Fan. It's none of your business. It's because your father failed to fulfill his responsibilities. You have been in poor health since you were a child, with weak energy and blood, and were plagued by diseases. You should not have been allowed to practice martial arts. It was me who insisted on letting you practice martial arts, but I didn't expect to turn you into the laughing stock of the family. The fault is all mine. I see all your efforts, and you are not wrong."

Lu Fan felt his eyes were slightly moist and clenched his fists.

Lu Hao continued: "Lu Fan, I want to hear your choice now. If you choose to leave the family, I will ensure that you go to the best town and take charge of the family's key business. You will be rich and stable for a lifetime, and there will be no problem."

"Well, he is indeed my son. He is not discouraged by defeat and is as strong as a rock. Lu Fan, I will do my best to help you."

With that said, Lu Hao took out a small blue and white porcelain bottle from his arms, handed it to Lu Fan and said, "Take it, this is the Li Gathering Pill. If you take it tonight, it will at least help you gain some strength first."

Lu Fan was stunned on the spot. His father actually gave him a bottle of elixir.

Lu Fan knew how precious pills were and how rare they were.This is something that only the extremely rare Qi Refiners in the Gangwu Continent can refine.

The so-called Qi Refiner is a noble profession.They have the power of a warrior, and they have more methods and stronger abilities than a warrior.The most outstanding thing is that they can use medicinal materials to refine various elixirs, each with different effects.It's much better than ordinary medicinal materials.

If it weren't for the small number of Qi Refiners and the high threshold, I'm afraid this continent wouldn't be called Gangwu Continent.

Lu Fan carefully finished the blue and white porcelain vase and was extremely moved.

The market price of even the lowest elixir is definitely higher than that of a few well-located shops, and there is still no market price.In an ordinary city like Jiang Lincheng, it is said that only one or two are sold at auction every year.

Lu Fan didn't know what price his father paid to get this pill, but looking at his father's white hair, Lu Fan knew that he was worried about him.

Lu Fan solemnly said: "Father, I will not let you down."

Lu Fan looked at his father's leaving figure and squeezed the medicine bottle in his hand tightly.
